# Antaios — EUDR Compliance Platform

Antaios is a B2B SaaS platform that helps importers comply with the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) (EU Regulation 2023/1115). It automates the extraction of compliance data from import documents, manages due diligence statements (DDS), triggers deforestation scans, and submits DDS to the TRACES system.

## Key Features
- Automated document data extraction (PDF, CSV, Excel, GeoJSON, images)
- Due Diligence Statement (DDS) management
- Global Forest Watch deforestation scanning
- TRACES system submission
- Risk assessment PDF generation
- Supplier data management via supplier portal
- Free compliance diagnostic (8 questions, no email required)

## EUDR Deadlines
- Large and medium enterprises: December 30, 2026
- Small and micro enterprises: June 30, 2027

## Covered Commodities
The EUDR covers seven commodities and their derivatives: cattle (beef and leather), cocoa, coffee, oil palm (palm oil), rubber, soya, and wood. Antaios provides compliance guidance for each.

## About
Antaios evaluates every shipment against all five EUDR criteria from Article 10(2): traceability, geolocation, documentation, attestations, and legality. Each criterion is scored green, amber, or red. Compliance records are retained for the full 5-year regulatory period.
